subject: Why Nora Lanelle exists
preview: One piece, one palette, a US brand. What comes this week, from Claire.
text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. You signed up yesterday, so one note on why this shop exists. I wanted a closet where every piece goes with every other piece: one palette, a coat that sits over the knit, a knit that sits over the trousers. A US brand, priced in USD, at your door in 7 to 10 days, thirty days at home, easy returns.

What comes this week: on day three, how our pictures are made and why the pieces are real. On day five, three looks from one palette and how to choose the first piece. Short notes, never daily.

One thing that does not wait: sizes. The Autumn Sale has 45% in every price, and the sizes go before the sale does. If a coat is on your list, look today, not next week.

https://nora-lanelle.com/collections/the-autumn-edit

Take care,
Claire
Nora Lanelle

P.S. WELCOME15 still takes 15% off your first piece at checkout.

subject: Three ways to wear it
preview: Your piece, worn over, under and alone, and the one care line that keeps it new.
headline:
One piece.
Three ways.
sub: About five weeks since it shipped, so it has had its first wears. Here are three more, each with pieces you likely already own. No code, nothing ending; the link goes to the looks.

blocks.headline: To town.
blocks.text: Your piece over a fine knit, trousers in the same tone, flat shoes. The palette does the work; nothing else needed.

blocks.headline: Off duty.
blocks.text: Same piece, a cardigan or a tee under it, jeans, no jewelry. The weekend version, two minutes to put on.

blocks.headline: After dark.
blocks.text: A slip dress or a satin skirt under it, black shoes. The piece stays; only the layer under it changes.

Read the label inside.
Knits lie flat, coats hang.
blocks.sub: The care label says wash or brush; knits dry flat, coats hang and air out overnight. Anything else about the piece: support@nora-lanelle.com, one to two business days.
